name: Black-and-chestnut Eagle
rangeDescription: Coastal mountains of venezuela to andes of northwestern argentina
description: Rare, crested eagle of middle- to upper-elevation cloud forest. Adult’s plumage is mostly black with chestnut on breast and belly.

name: Cozumel Vireo
rangeDescription: Cozumel (just off yucatán peninsula)
description: Only on Cozumel Island, Mexico, where no similar species occur. Uncommon; has declined thanks to predation by non-native boa constrictor snakes released on the island.

name: Providence Petrel
rangeDescription: Breeds lord howe island and philip island; ranges to northwestern pacific
description: Heavyset, gray-brownish seabird of the open Pacific Ocean, with pale patches in the underwings at the primary feathers and indistinct pale feathering around the bill base. Upperparts sometimes show grayish, almost silvery grizzled appearance.

name: Bornean Ground-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Borneo
description: Secretive pheasant-like cuckoo that is more often heard than seen; listen for its dove-like “coo-KOO” song and odd sneeze-like call. Beautiful if seen well: iridescent purple-green wings, long dark tail, finely barred underparts, black head, and pale blue-green face and bill.

name: Black-throated Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Humid forest and scrub of eastern brazil to paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: A largely grayish grosbeak found in the middle to upper levels of humid and montane forests. Males are slaty-blue overall with a black face and throat contrasting with a bright red bill.

name: Pale-eyed Blackbird
rangeDescription: Locally in marshes of eastern ecuador and eastern peru
description: Medium-sized blackbird found locally in habitats with wet grass. Shiny black, with a white or light yellow eye and sharply pointed black bill.

name: Kauai Elepaio
rangeDescription: Kauai (hawaiian islands)
description: A small flycatcher of forested habitats on Kauai. Adults have a gray back and white wingbars, while immatures are reddish brown with buffy wingbars.

name: Chestnut-crested Antbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia and adjacent northwestern brazil
description: Striking, medium-sized antbird, brown above and rich chestnut below, with a black face and broad white bare eye-ring. Females have thin black bars above.

name: Cajamarca Antpitta
rangeDescription: Andes of northern peru (cajamarca)
description: Small antpitta with a restricted range in the western Andes of northwestern Peru. Note the chestnut brown plumage and pale belly; like other antpittas, it has long legs and a short tail.

name: Bay-chested Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: Scrub of southeastern brazil (minas gerais to northern río grande do sul)
description: Small finch with a conspicuous chestnut breast and flanks. Gray above with a white throat and belly and a white arc below the eye.

name: Wilson's Bird-of-Paradise
rangeDescription: Waigeo and batanta (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A fairly small bird of foothill forest on Waigeo and Batanta islands. Dark blue feet and strange pale blue skin on the top of the head divided by thin, black lines.

name: Violet-chested Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela and coastal cordillera eastward to miranda
description: Attractive large hummingbird, green and long billed with an iridescent violet patch on chest (male), orange wing patch, and white tipped tail. Both sexes have buff scaling on underparts; female has a white moustache and buffy scaled throat and chest.

name: Pantanal Snipe
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to trinidad, the guianas, brazil, and northern argentina
description: Cryptic shorebird found predominately in lowland wet grasslands and flooded fields. Note the long straight bill, white belly with variegated cryptic plumage, and prominent contrasting pale lines on the face and back.

name: Slaty Bristlefront
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia and espírito santo to eastern paraná and santa catarina)
description: Odd-looking terrestrial species with a long tail and a small tufty crest. Found in the understory of humid and montane forests and is rarely easy to see.

name: Marsh Babbler
rangeDescription: Northeastern india (arunachal pradesh to cachar, khasi, and chittagong hills)
description: A small, mostly brown bird with a heavily streaked pale breast. Note the white eyebrow, the white throat, and the rusty flanks and belly.

name: Guianan Gnatcatcher
rangeDescription: The guianas (guyana, suriname, and french guiana) southward to the amazon river
description: Inconspicuous and rarely seen bird of rainforest canopy. Small and slender with a long tail; mostly dark gray with a broken white eyering, white belly, and white outer tail feathers.

name: Naung Mung Scimitar-Babbler
rangeDescription: Sub-himalayan myanmar
description: Strange short-tailed babbler with a long decurved bill. Currently only known from the far northern tip of Myanmar, and potentially adjacent border regions of southwestern China.

name: Southern Red Bishop
rangeDescription: Western and southern angola, southern and eastern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, kenya, and tanzania, southward to south africa
description: A small, dumpy sparrow-like weaver. The breeding male is a mix of velvety vermilion and black; the narrow black forecrown is diagnostic.

name: Mottle-backed Elaenia
rangeDescription: Tropical southeastern colombia to eastern ecuador, eastern peru, and western bolivia
description: Large elaenia with a striking headdress. It inhabits lightly-wooded areas, such as overgrown clearings, forest edge, and river islands, along the eastern base of the Andes.

name: Buff-breasted Wheatear
rangeDescription: Highlands of southwestern arabia (mecca to yemen)
description: A chunky, pale, brownish wheatear of mountain habitats in southwestern Arabia. Note the white eyebrow, black eye stripe, clean white throat, and buff breast.
